lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines observed; spacing is wider at the anterior and posterior extremities of the torso and more compressed in the center.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation located in the superior-medial region of the torso where a vertical line splits into two branches before reaching the dorsal crest.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several line segments are truncated or dashed, particularly in the lower-central torso region where they fail to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower lateral haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spot-blobs is visible across the mid-thigh region.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a backward and then inward curvature, beginning at an approximately 45-degree angle from the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on approximately the top 15 percent of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white chevron mark located between the eyes and a prominent dark shaggy fringe along the ventral midline.
